query: select "trips"."id", "trips"."trip_data", "trips"."capacity", "trips"."vehicle_id", "trips"."driver_id", "trips"."visibility", "trips"."route_id", "trips"."company_id", "routes"."id", "routes"."name", "routes"."origin", "routes"."stops", "routes"."destination", "routes"."company_id", "users"."id", "users"."first_name", "users"."last_name", "users"."email", "users"."password", "users"."role", "users"."company", "users"."profile_picture", "users"."created_at", "users"."updated_at", "users"."invited_by_id", "users"."company_id", "users"."commission_percentage", "users"."commission_enabled", "users"."cash_box_enabled", "vehicles"."id", "vehicles"."plates", "vehicles"."brand", "vehicles"."model", "vehicles"."economic_number", "vehicles"."capacity", "vehicles"."has_ac", "vehicles"."has_reclining_seats", "vehicles"."services", "vehicles"."description", "vehicles"."created_at", "vehicles"."updated_at", "vehicles"."company_id" from "trips" left join "routes" on "trips"."route_id" = "routes"."id" left join "users" on "trips"."driver_id" = "users"."id" left join "vehicles" on "trips"."vehicle_id" = "vehicles"."id" where ("trips"."visibility" = $1 and "trips"."company_id" = $2 and "trips"."driver_id" = $3)
